title: CollectionObservationV1
description: Event record created when a collection sync run observes an item at a specific position in a specific page.

schema_version.description: Schema version for collection observation events.

sync_run_id.description: Foreign key reference to sync-run-v1 session.

observed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the observation.

page_number.description: 1-based page index within this sync run.

position_in_page.description: 0-based element index within the returned page array.

global_rank_seen.description: 1-based sequential rank observed from cursor=0 in this sync run.

page_request_cursor.description: The cursor parameter sent when requesting this page.

page_response_cursor.description: The next_cursor returned in the response envelope of this page.

is_first_observation.description: True if this content ID had never been seen prior to this sync run.

is_reappearance.description: True if this content ID was already known in DB but reappeared at collection head (re-favorite).
